WITH customer_totals AS (
  SELECT CustomerID,
         SUM(Amount * Price) AS total_price,
         SUM(Amount) AS total_amount
  FROM transactions_1k
  GROUP BY CustomerID
),
top_customer AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, total_price, total_amount
  FROM customer_totals
  ORDER BY total_price DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT tc.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
       tc.total_price / NULLIF(tc.total_amount, 0) AS AveragePricePerItem,
       c.Currency AS Currency
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID;
